finding.title: Route LearningLedgerCodec.encode's completedAt through FirestoreCodec.encodeDateTime instead of raw toIso8601String()
finding.rule: Evans consistency (single documented UTC-safe conversion path) / data-integrity
finding.why: Every other DateTime field in all 14 sibling codecs — and every other field in this very file (see decode() at line 84-86) — is pushed via FirestoreCodec.encodeDateTime, which forces `.toUtc()` before serializing so the wire string always carries a 'Z' suffix. This one call skips it. entry.completedAt is read back from Drift's `dateTime()` column which, per the pinned drift-2.31.0 source (lib/src/runtime/types/mapping.dart:174, default storeDateTimesAsText=false, not overridden anywhere in this repo), decodes via `DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(unixSeconds*1000)` with no isUtc:true — producing a **local**, non-UTC-flagged DateTime even though the original value came from DateTimeFactory.nowUtc(). `.toIso8601String()` on a non-UTC DateTime omits the 'Z'/offset entirely. When a different device (a parent or tutor on a different device/timezone — an explicitly supported flow in this app, see tutor_grant_codec.dart in this same batch) pulls the row, FirestoreCodec.parseDateTime's `DateTime.tryParse(raw)?.toUtc()` (used by learning_ledger_merger.dart) reinterprets the offset-naive string using the READING device's local offset rather than the writer's, shifting completedAt by the delta between the two devices' UTC offsets — potentially moving a ledger entry onto the wrong calendar day on the syncing device.
finding.recommendation: Change line 67 to `'completed_at': FirestoreCodec.encodeDateTime(model.completedAt),` to match every sibling codec.
acceptance_criteria: Regression test: encode a LearningLedgerRow with a non-UTC-flagged completedAt (isUtc:false, simulating the Drift round-trip) and assert the resulting 'completed_at' string ends in 'Z' and represents the correct UTC instant.
learning_ledger_roundtrip_test.dart extended so decode(encode(x)) is timezone-independent (passes under a non-UTC ambient TZ).
